open_points.subject: A14 rule 2 (resume authority after grant revocation)
open_points.text: "...its unused approval (M24), which is used first when both exist, or a grant still active; an element whose grant was revoked meanwhile waits for approval instead."
open_points.question: If a matching approved-unused approval exists but the standing grant was revoked, should resume use that approval or force a new approval wait?
options: Use the existing approved-unused approval (because approvals win when both exist).
Force owner_approval wait whenever the grant was the prior authority and is now revoked.

open_points.subject: Capture failed execution eligibility vs run end state
open_points.text: State 0 failure list for capture refuses "...or whose run was already released (its files are gone)"; A15 rule 5 says capture is allowed only while "the run has not ended, or ended `failed` and was not released".
open_points.question: Are failed executions from ended `refused`/`cancelled` runs always non-capturable, even when their captured inputs would be value-only (no file needed)?
options: A15 is strict: only running or ended-failed-unreleased runs are capturable.
State 0 intent is narrower: only release should block capture; ended non-failed runs may still be capturable when files are irrelevant.
open_points.default_guess: Apply A15 strictly and refuse capture once run ended unless it is `failed` and unreleased.

open_points.subject: A03 cleanup failure vs A04 admission completion
open_points.text: A04 rule 2: "Admission ... never stops early." A03 rule 7: "...execution is recorded `crashed` with detail `cleanup_failed`, and the kernel process stops."
open_points.question: If `cleanup_failed` occurs during admission over multiple trial cases, does admission persist a partial set of TrialExecutions and no verdict, or must the whole admission call be rolled back to preserve 'never stops early'?
options: Persist what was recorded before stop; no verdict if corpus was not completed.
Abort/rollback the admission transaction so no partial admission evidence remains.
open_points.default_guess: Persist recorded executions and leave no verdict for that corpus run.
